# Universal Game Launcher v1.4.0

> Cross-platform universal game library with modular plugin engine, dynamic i18next localization, and authoritative HELIX Gaming DB multi-shard federation.

---

## 📖 Overview

**Universal Game Launcher v1.4.0** marks a major evolutionary milestone for the application, completing the full transition from Steam Vault to a truly universal, privacy-focused, and extensible game organizer and launcher. Built with Tauri v2 and SvelteKit, this release brings together games across Steam, GOG, Epic Games, itch.io, standalone executables, and retro console emulation under a cohesive obsidian dark interface.

This release introduces native integration with the **HELIX Gaming DB** REST API across all four volume shards (`00` through `03`), featuring multi-shard search index aggregation, direct Cloudflare edge proxy acceleration, and dual-tier content segregation. Additionally, the entire localization pipeline has been re-architected with **i18next**, dynamically loading 12 primary language bundles covering both app interface strings and video game taxonomies with persistent SQLite offline caching.

---

## ✨ Highlights

- **Universal Game Launcher Architecture** — Unified library management across Steam, GOG, Epic Games (native or Legendary CLI), itch.io, standalone executables, and retro console emulators.
- **Universal Core Plugins Engine** — Drop-in native modular architecture (`platform-universal`, `metadata-universal`, `metadata-helix`, `utility-title-normalizer`, `media-universal`, `utility-deals`, `utility-patchnotes`, `utility-storage`).
- **Authoritative HELIX Gaming DB Integration** — Distributed multi-shard federation across `ugl-db-00`, `01`, `02`, and `03`, Cloudflare Edge direct routing, and unified search index aggregation.
- **Dynamic `i18next` Localization Core** — Replaces static dictionaries with dynamic remote bundles (`/api/v2/i18n/{code}/bundle.json`), dual UI and taxonomy namespaces, 7-day SQLite KV caching, and RTL layout support.
- **Automated Continuous Integration Matrix** — Dual-stage CI workflows on Windows and Linux verifying frontend diagnostics and Rust backend tests on every push.

## 🚀 What's Changed

### 🌟 Added
- **Universal Multi-Platform Game Library**:
  - Full desktop library organization for Steam, GOG, Epic Games, itch.io, standalone games, and retro console ROMs.
  - Dedicated standalone game addition modal with directory scanner and title normalizer.
  - Enhanced manual metadata editor with custom capsule, hero, and metadata overrides.
- **Modular Universal Core Plugins Framework (`src/lib/plugins/`)**:
  - Modular native plugin framework consolidating platform providers and metadata extractors without external eval vulnerabilities.
  - Non-blocking background worker execution for storage space inspection and multi-source library scanning.
- **Authoritative HELIX Gaming DB Integration (`metadata-helix`)**:
  - Multi-shard volume federation querying across `ugl-db-00`, `01`, `02`, and `03`.
  - Consolidated search index aggregation and deduplication with SQLite KV persistence.
  - Cloudflare Edge direct shard proxy support (`https://api.helix-origin.club/{shard}/api/...`) with resilient raw CDN fallback.
  - Three-tier catalog segregation: `v1` legacy, `v2` family/general indie & retro, and `v3` adult 18+ titles.
- **Dynamic `i18next` Localization Engine**:
  - Modern `i18next` client library integration replacing hardcoded dictionary files.
  - Live remote edge bundle loading (`/api/v2/i18n/{code}/bundle.json`) for 12 primary languages (`en`, `ja`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`, `es`, `fr`, `de`, `it`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `ko`, `pl`).
  - Dual UI (`app.json`) and metadata taxonomy (`genres`, `categories`, `platforms`, `common`) support in a single atomic payload.
  - Persistent SQLite KV caching (`i18n_bundle_{code}`) delivering instant 0ms offline startup.
  - Dynamic RTL (Right-to-Left) layout support for Arabic and robust English fallback chains.
- **Automated CI Workflow**:
  - Deployed `.github/workflows/ci.yml` verifying frontend type safety (`svelte-check`) and Rust backend compilation and unit tests (`cargo check`, `cargo test --lib`) on `windows-latest` and `ubuntu-22.04`.

### 🔄 Changed
- **Centralized Documentation Decoupling**:
  - Migrated detailed technical guides and wikis to organization hubs ([docs.helix-origin.club](https://docs.helix-origin.club/universal-game-launcher/) and [wiki.helix-origin.club](https://wiki.helix-origin.club/universal-game-launcher/)).
  - Streamlined repository `README.md` into a minimal, clean entry point.

### 🛡️ Security, Hygiene & Compliance
- **Organization Standards Compliance**:
  - Canonical MIT license harmonization across manifests and source headers.
  - Standardized all repository shields and badges to raw HTML `<a><img ... height="20" /></a>`.
